description: A choice that appears once the customer picks the choice it sits under - a handle type or motor under Manual or Motorized, or a colour under a slat width. Rows with the same Group are shown together, in the order of the grid.

fields.label: Shown Under
fields.description: The choice this appears under: Manual, Motorized, or any other choice on this product - e.g. 5 cm for the colours of the 5 cm slat.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: e.g. Handle Type, Motor Type, Motor Position. Rows with the same group are offered together.

fields.label: Only For These Sizes
fields.description: For motors, which are rated for a size. Leave at 0 for any size. A choice outside the customer's size is not offered.

fields.label: Swatch Photo
fields.description: Optional. With a photo the choice is shown as a swatch; under a colour or material step, picking it also colours the blind in the 3D view.
